notes:
Zone (verified in the model). Plan label cell converted with the first-floor plan calibration (X = −18.8 + px·0.029984, Y = 7.83 − (py−187)·0.030273), then ray casts into the original GLB (typical_rooms/probe_new.py, probe_new2.py): each wall face = median of 7 parallel casts at floor + 1.0 m, doorways and windows from scans 0.25 m inside each face at floor + 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.2 m, floor and soffit measured at 5 points in this room (floor 2.44, soffit 2.56 m above it). Doors: W wall -2.70..-1.85 to the lobby (open leaf into the lobby). Windows on the s wall.

Photos. washroom male.webp (style reference only: the 'washroom male' photo is a watermarked stock image (as for the ground-floor Gents), kept off the page). People in photos are ignored.

Built as new objects. Fixtures. Two wall-hung urinals on the black mosaic wall, a wall-hung basin with mirror on the blue mosaic, two grey HPL cubicles (one open), steel hand dryer, soap dispenser, yellow tactile strips, white 600 tiles, round downlights. Fit check: every footprint inside the zone and clear of the doors (check_layout.py), every built object inside the zone and every 360 node ≥ 0.30 m from anything (check_scene.py).

Dropped (real scale, no shrinking).

  • two of the four urinals of the ground-floor Gents: the 3.24 m north wall takes the basin and two urinals at 0.60 m
  • the third cubicle: the 1.72 m east wall takes two 0.86 m cubicles (1.40 m deep)
  • the soap dispenser beside the basin (it would sit over the first urinal): it is on the west wall by the door

Differences. (1) The model has no suspended ceiling: a 600 mm grid with LED panels is built at 2.51 m. (2) Door openings and windows are the model's; a door leaf of the upper-floor scene stands open in this room's renders only.
